Not reported: wavelength, Vpi frequency or bias, electrode type/geometry, propagation or RF loss, Z0, n_rf, ng, film thickness, energy per bit.

ER over 25 dB across the C band for all child and parent MZIs (Fig. 2b; Table 1). Wavelength 1550 nm is one of three Fig. 2(c) curves (1527, 1550, 1565 nm), Vpi 1.5 V held over the C band.
